infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wakajor needs access to your camera to take photos of your profile picture and vehicle documents. For example, you can use the camera to capture a photo of your vehicle registration document or profile picture.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wakajor needs microphone access for calling drivers and passengers directly through the app.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Wakajor needs access to your location to find nearby drivers and provide accurate ride matching. Your location is used to show nearby drivers on the map and match you with the closest available driver for faster pickup times.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Wakajor needs access to your location to find nearby drivers and provide accurate ride matching. Your location is used to show nearby drivers on the map and match you with the closest available driver for faster pickup times.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Wakajor needs access to your location to find nearby drivers and provide accurate ride matching. Your location is used to show nearby drivers on the map and match you with the closest available driver for faster pickup times.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Wakajor needs access to your photo library to upload your profile picture and vehicle documents. For example, you can select a photo of your vehicle registration or profile picture from your photo library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Wakajor needs access to save photos to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Wakajor would like to track your activity across other apps and websites to provide personalized ride matching and improve our services. This helps us connect you with nearby drivers more efficiently.

plugins.photosPermission: Wakajor needs access to your photo library to upload your profile picture and vehicle documents. For example, you can select a photo of your vehicle registration or profile picture from your photo library.
